patch_description:
Dramatically reduce parameter count via:
1. Use single global parameters shared across all 8 qubits (e.g., one "ry_global" for all RY gates)
2. Replace fixed CZ chain with parametrized Ising couplings (XX/YY/ZZ) to create more expressive entanglement with fewer parameters
3. Use controlled rotations on alternating pairs with shared parameters
4. Remove the post-RZ layer which adds 8 parameters with unclear benefit

This reduces parameters from 24 distinct to ~6-8 distinct per block, dramatically improving parameter efficiency and generalization on held-out test data. The model will be forced to learn generalizable features rather than fitting noise, which should improve worst_group_margin (the dominant scoring term).

The Ising couplings are known to be efficient for quantum state discrimination tasks and create global entanglement patterns that capture correlations better than linear chains.
